summary_en: 400,000 shares (3.4% of shares outstanding), ¥15.0B limit, open-market purchase, Aug 3–Nov 30, 2026. All acquired shares to be cancelled Dec 15, 2026. Stated reason: to enhance per-share shareholder value and capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice Regarding Authorization of Share Acquisition Framework and Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: Nabtesco's board resolved on July 31, 2026, to establish an authorization to acquire up to 4.0 million shares (3.4% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury) for a maximum aggregate consideration of ¥15.0 billion. Purchases will be executed via open-market transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between August 3 and November 30, 2026. All shares acquired under this program are mandated to be cancelled on December 15, 2026. The stated purpose is to enhance per-share shareholder value and improve capital efficiency. As of June 30, 2026, Nabtesco held 417,022 treasury shares against an issued capital of 118,064,699 shares (excluding treasury).
